Features shearling interior lining as a faithful recreation of the iconic outerwear staple.

 

· Asymmetrical zipper closure

· Shearling interior lining

· Contrasting shearling trims

A statement piece from our F/W 2024 collection, this unisex sweatshirt features a cracked “E” typography graphic and numerical detailing on the sleeves, embodying the collection’s bold, dystopian aesthetic. Designed with a crewneck and a slight oversized fit, it offers a relaxed, college-style vibe for everyday wear.

Key Details:

• Cracked “E” Graphic Print: Adds a bold, edgy visual element.

• Oversized Unisex Fit: Ensures comfort and versatility.

• Dropped Shoulders: Enhances the casual, laid-back silhouette.

• Ribbed Collar, Cuffs, & Hemline: Provides structure and a clean finish.

• Crewneck Design: Timeless and easy to style.

This biker-inspired cropped jacket combines edgy design with practical functionality. Featuring padded shoulder patches and a waxed coating for a water-repellent finish, it merges bold aesthetics with all-weather wearability. The concealed snap button collar and tasseled zippers add striking details, while the cropped silhouette ensures a modern fit.

Key Details:

• Cropped Cut: A contemporary silhouette that pairs well with high-waisted pieces.

• Padded Shoulders: Adds structure and a nod to classic biker styles.

• Patch Pockets: Functional front pockets with button and zip closures.

• Tasseled Zippers: Enhances the jacket’s rebellious, biker-inspired vibe.

• Waxed Coating: Provides a sleek finish with water-repellent properties.

title_en: HEAVY WASHED WORK WEAR JKT - CAMEL

body_html:
A near-future dystopian reinterpretation of the classic workwear jacket. Crafted with a relaxed hip-length cut and dropped shoulders, this all-season staple offers a modern boxy silhouette. The distressed heavy-wash canvas brings a rugged edge, while the contrasting corduroy collar and tonal top-stitching add subtle refinement.

Key Details:

•  1886 Stamp Logo Print: A signature branding element for understated style.

•  Distressed Canvas: Adds character and a worn-in feel.

•  Contrast Corduroy Collar: Elevates the design with texture and contrast.

•  Zip Front Closure: Functional and easy for everyday wear.

Elevate your athleisure wardrobe with these timeless tracksuit pants, designed to pair perfectly with the matching crushed satin jacket for a coordinated 2-piece set. Drawing inspiration from the ’90s, the rope side piping adds a vintage touch, while the crushed satin fabric delivers a luxurious finish.

Key Details:

• Crushed Satin Fabric: For a sleek and refined texture.

• Adjustable Elastic Waistband: Ensures a comfortable, customizable fit.

• Relaxed Straight Leg Fit: Combines ease of movement with a modern silhouette.

• Rope Piping: A nod to the ’90s aesthetic central to the F/W 2024 collection.

• 1886 Chainstitch Logo: Embroidered subtly on the left leg panel for understated branding.

A refined take on classic sportswear, this black long sleeve track jacket blends sleek design with elevated details. Crafted from creased satin for a subtle sheen, it features tonal hardware and an exposed zipper closure. The tonal embroidered 1886 chainstitch logo adds understated branding, while rope piping enhances its sharp silhouette. 

Key Details:

•  Creased Satin Fabric: Offers a sophisticated texture and subtle shine.

•  1886 Chainstitch Logo: Embroidered on the chest for a minimal yet distinct finish.

•  Rope Piping: Adds structure and visual interest to the design.

•  Elastic Hem & Cuffs: Ensures a snug, comfortable fit.

These classic ‘90s-inspired sweatpants are part of the athleisure range for our Fall/Winter 2024 collection. Cut with an oversized, relaxed fit for everyday wear. Made with cotton for all-day comfort. Style with matching speed zip-up hoodie for a coordinating 2-piece set. Features a contrasting pink 1886 text logo in a retro-inspired font.

 

· Wide cuffs for oversized fit

· Elastic drawstring waistband

· Contrasting red 1886 logo graphic

· “Speed” graphic print

· 100% cotton

This unisex hoodie pays homage to the ‘90s clubbing lifestyle with bold flame graphics along the sleeves and a reimagined 1886 logo. The back features a striking falcon emblem, tying into the dystopian themes of our Fall/Winter 2024 collection. Crafted from 100% cotton, it offers a relaxed fit with a dropped shoulder design and a functional kangaroo front pocket for added versatility.

Key Details:

•  ‘Flame’ Graphic Print: Vibrant sleeve design inspired by ‘90s club culture.

•  Falcon Emblem Back Print: A bold statement element that enhances the hoodie’s narrative.

•  Reimagined 1886 Logo: A modern take on our iconic branding.

•  Relaxed Fit: Unisex and oversized for everyday comfort.

•  Dropped Shoulders: Adds to the casual, laid-back aesthetic.

•  Ribbed Cuffs & Hem: Ensures a snug and structured finish.

•  100% Cotton: Soft, breathable, and ideal for year-round wear.

Versatile and utilitarian, these textured nylon cargo pants are designed with a loose, straight fit and multifunctional features. The 2-in-1 design includes a zip-off lower half, allowing the pants to transform into knee-length shorts, making them perfect for year-round wear.

Crafted with multiple patch pockets, these mid-waist pants combine practicality and style. The adjustable waistband ensures a comfortable fit, while the monochromatic detailing adds a sleek, tactical edge to this wardrobe staple.

Key Features:

• 2-in-1 design with a zip-off lower half for easy conversion to shorts

• Textured nylon fabric for durability and a modern look

• Multiple cargo pockets for functional storage

• Adjustable waistband for a customizable fit

• Zip fly closure for ease of wear

A bold fusion of contemporary design and versatility, this skirt-jeans hybrid redefines statement dressing. Crafted from grey faded wash non-stretch denim, it features a unique silhouette with one loose straight-leg cut and the other slashed into a wrap-style skirt.

Part of our Fall/Winter 2024 womenswear collection, this mid-waist design is finished with tonal topstitching and a branded dark metal plaque on the belt loop for subtle sophistication. With a 5-pocket construction and a zip fly with button closure, this hybrid piece pairs effortlessly with any shoe style for a fashion-forward look.

Key Features:

•  Grey faded wash non-stretch denim for a vintage-inspired finish

•  Hybrid design combining a straight-leg cut and wrap-style skirt

•  Mid-waist silhouette with a relaxed fit

•  Tonal topstitching for a refined touch

•  Branded dark metal plaque on the belt loop

•  Zip fly with button closure

A refined take on a classic silhouette. This unisex trench coat combines a relaxed fit with structured details, making it a versatile staple for any wardrobe.

Part of our Fall/Winter 2024 collection, this double-breasted trench features oversized pockets and tonal monochromatic buttons for a touch of understated elegance. The slim belt offers styling versatility, allowing for a cinched, tailored look or a more relaxed, open fit.

This utilitarian piece is elevated with a futuristic edge, crafted from transparent dynamic nylon fabric for a modern, distinctive finish.

Key Features:

•  Double-breasted button closure

•  Relaxed yet structured fit

•  Slim belt for versatile styling

•  Oversized pockets for practicality

Inspired by a retro mid-90s depiction of a technologically driven dystopian future, this hoodie merges nostalgia with forward-thinking design. Crafted from soft cotton, it features a “Rave Head” graphic print and matching stitched detailing, all in classic black. With a relaxed, unisex fit, ribbed cuffs and hem, and a front kangaroo pocket, it delivers comfort and style in equal measure.

Key Details:

• ‘Rave Head’ Graphic Print: A bold design that captures the collection’s dystopian narrative.

• Relaxed Fit: Unisex and versatile, perfect for casual wear.

• Kangaroo Pocket: Adds practicality and a timeless hoodie detail.

• Ribbed Cuffs & Hem: Ensures a clean, structured finish.

• Dropped Shoulders: Enhances the laid-back silhouette.

A core staple from our F/W 2024 collection, this college-style crewneck embodies effortless versatility. Featuring embroidered Roman numerals for “1886,” it offers a subtle, sophisticated nod to the brand’s identity. Made from soft-touch cotton and designed with a relaxed fit, it’s perfect for casual, everyday wear and easy to style with track pants, denim, or cargo shorts.

Key Details:

• Roman Numeral Embroidery: A refined detail that celebrates 1886’s legacy.

• Relaxed Fit: Designed for all-day comfort and casual styling.

• “Goblet” Graphic Print: Adds a unique visual element.

• Dropped Shoulders: Enhances the laid-back silhouette.

• Ribbed Cuffs & Hem: Ensures structure and a polished finish.

A contemporary reinterpretation of the classic plaid shirt, this button-up design embraces a near-future dystopian aesthetic central to our F/W 2024 collection. The distressed detailing along the hemline and stitching adds a raw, edgy finish, while the relaxed, slightly oversized fit ensures effortless comfort and versatility.

Key Details:

•  Plaid Check Design: A timeless pattern reimagined for modern style.

•  Relaxed Fit: Provides a casual yet elevated silhouette.

•  Distressed Hemline & Stitching: Adds texture and a rugged edge.

•  Pointed Shirt Collar: A classic touch to balance the bold design.

Paying tribute to the ‘90s clubbing lifestyle, this women’s hoodie combines nostalgia with a dystopian edge. Part of our Fall/Winter 2024 collection, it features bold flame graphics along the sleeves and a striking falcon emblem back print. The reimagined 1886 logo adds a modern twist, while the oversized kangaroo pocket, relaxed fit, and dropped shoulders ensure comfort and style.

Key Details:

• ‘Flame’ Graphic Print: Bold sleeve detailing inspired by ‘90s clubbing culture.

• Falcon Emblem Back Print: A standout design that ties into the collection’s narrative.

• Reimagined 1886 Logo: A fresh take on our signature branding.

• Relaxed Fit: Oversized and casual for effortless layering.

• Dropped Shoulders: Enhances the laid-back silhouette.

 • Ribbed Cuffs & Hem: Adds structure and a polished finish.

Crafted from premium cotton, this double-fabric hoodie is designed for ultimate comfort and durability. The interior features a soft lining for added warmth and a luxurious feel, making it perfect for layering in cooler weather.

Bold and innovative, these hybrid leather pants reimagine mid-90s fashion through a futuristic, dystopian lens. Crafted from cracked, manipulated leather, they feature a relaxed fit and mid-waist silhouette with a concealed zipper and button closure.

Part of our Fall/Winter 2024 collection, these deliberately distressed pants are enhanced with 3-dimensional padding and quilted knee patches, adding depth and texture. Perfectly versatile, they can be styled effortlessly with a t-shirt or hoodie for a standout look that blends utility with high-concept design.

Key Features:

•  Cracked leather construction with a distressed, futuristic finish

•  Relaxed fit mid-waist silhouette for comfortable wear

•  Concealed zipper and button closure for a sleek look

•  3-dimensional padding for added structure and visual interest

•  Quilted knee patches for durability and style

Paying homage to the tradition of biker trousers, these fitted straight-leg pants are crafted from painted cracked leather for a bold, distressed aesthetic. Heavy flat-lock stitching and ribbed knee patches add depth and texture, elevating this classic style with a futuristic edge.

Part of our Fall/Winter 2024 collection, these trousers reimagine mid-90s club culture through a dystopian lens, blending vintage-inspired elements with modern design. The wide hem ensures versatility, making them suitable for all styles of shoes while maintaining a fitted silhouette.

Key Features:

•  Distressed cracked leather for a vintage, textured finish

•  Ribbed knee patches for added durability and style

•  Heavy flat-lock stitching for bold detailing

•  Fitted straight-leg cut for a sleek silhouette

•  Wide hem for versatile styling options

Part of our Fall/Winter 2024 menswear collection, this American Western-inspired ranch coat merges timeless craftsmanship with contemporary design. Crafted from top-grain genuine leather, it features a textured, aged finish for a vintage distressed look.

Cut in a relaxed silhouette with a below-hip length, this coat offers effortless style and comfort. Details like the concealed 2-way zipper closure, slanted zip pockets, and Western-stitched yoke add functional elegance and an authentic nod to classic Western wear.

Key Features:

•  Top-grain genuine leather with an aged, vintage finish

•  Relaxed fit with a below-hip cut for versatile styling

•  Western-stitched yoke for a classic ranch-inspired design

•  Concealed 2-way zipper closure for a streamlined look

•  Slanted zip pockets for practicality

A utilitarian twist on evening wear, this wool rib-knit dress from our Fall/Winter 2024 collection combines elegance with functionality. Designed in an army green hue, it features a half-turtleneck collar, velcro shoulder patches, and a floor-length silhouette with a side slit. The slender fit naturally elongates and flatters, while the patch epaulets add a bold, utility-inspired edge.

Key Details:

• Ribbed Knit Stitch: Provides texture and a figure-enhancing fit.

• Velcro Shoulder Patches: A utilitarian detail for a modern twist.

• Floor-Length Silhouette: Offers an elegant and slimming look.

• Side Slit: Adds movement and a subtle touch of allure.

• 100% Wool: Warm, soft, and perfect for cooler evenings.
